apple.decision: Retain original serial Data.write(.atomic) and original owner ACK. Before API entry the old file survives; after API return but before original owner ACK a new process recovers complete pending and commits once.
apple.scope: Two exact observed original test-host SIGKILLs on Apple Simulator, with fresh original Model readers. The internal temporary write/sync/rename point inside Data.write is opaque and untested.
